title: Hierarchical 4-Level Neural + Roster-Conditioned Transformer for NBA Prediction

sources.title: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues
sources.key_finding: Hierarchical 4-level neural architecture: Layer 1=player ability embeddings, Layer 2=player synergy modelling, Layer 3=team-level effects, Layer 4=game matchup prediction. ~1.4M parameters. Consistently outperforms flat XGBoost/LR on Brier.

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sources.key_finding: Roster-conditioned temporal transformer: processes each team's full season history with player-level attention (~25M params). LR achieves Brier 0.199, XGBoost 0.202 as strong baselines. Monte Carlo dropout at inference for calibrated uncertainty.

sources.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sources.key_finding: Stacked ensemble with LR meta-learner on tree base learners (XGBoost+LightGBM+ExtraTrees) outperforms individual models. CPU-legal.

summary: Two GPU-only SOTA architectures identified this cycle. The hierarchical 4-level neural models player synergy explicitly, capturing lineup combinations that flat models miss. The roster-conditioned transformer processes sequential team history at player granularity. Both require GPU (Colab/Kaggle A100/P100) but the feature insights are CPU-applicable: player synergy proxy features should be added to engine.py.

actionable_cpu_legal.action: Stacked ensemble with LR meta-learner on XGBoost+LightGBM+ExtraTrees base
actionable_cpu_legal.note: Rule#8 CPU-only — no neural stacking, tree-only ensemble legal
